mechanism: Echinacea may inhibit CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing rasagiline concentrations; additionally, both agents possess immunostimulatory properties that could theoretically interact.
action: Monitor patients for increased rasagiline adverse effects (nausea, orthostatic hypotension, headache); counsel on echinacea use and consider alternative herbal supplements with lower enzyme-inhibition potential.
